# Copilot Prompt Library

This folder adapts the workflows from `agent/workflows` into native GitHub Copilot prompt files.

## Available prompts

- `brainstorm.prompt.md`
- `create.prompt.md`
- `debug.prompt.md`
- `deploy.prompt.md`
- `enhance.prompt.md`
- `orchestrate.prompt.md`
- `plan.prompt.md`
- `preview.prompt.md`
- `status.prompt.md`
- `test.prompt.md`
- `ui-ux-pro-max.prompt.md`

## Usage

In Copilot Chat, invoke prompts by name and pass context with your request.
Example intents:
- brainstorm analytics dashboard revamp
- debug student evaluation submit issue
- enhance dean results table filters
- ui ux pro max redesign guidance dashboard
